records.fix: Reply to new hire questions within one working day
Pair each new hire with a lunch buddy for the first month
Hands-on machine training before the first solo shift

out.steps: Please conduct hands-on machine training with new hires before assigning them their first solo shift. Guide them through equipment operation, safety protocols, and standard operating procedures step by step, ensuring they can operate the machinery safely and confidently on their own.

notes.en: You will participate in practical, hands-on machine training guided by your manager before your first solo shift to ensure safe and confident equipment operation.
notes.ms: Anda akan menyertai latihan praktikal pengendalian mesin bersama pengurus anda sebelum syif solo pertama untuk memastikan pengendalian peralatan yang selamat dan yakin.
notes.zh: 在您开始第一次单独轮班之前，您将接受管理人员的实操机械培训，以确保您能安全且熟练地操作设备。

records.fix: Cap overtime at 2 hours a day for the first 4 weeks

out.steps: Please cap daily overtime for new hires at a maximum of two hours per day during their first four weeks. Monitor their schedules closely, adjust daily task assignments to prevent excessive hours, and ensure they log off promptly once the two-hour overtime limit is reached.

notes.en: To support your onboarding and well-being, overtime is capped at a maximum of two hours per day during your first four weeks. Your manager will help adjust your workload accordingly.
notes.ms: Bagi menyokong penyesuaian dan kesejahteraan anda, kerja lebih masa dihadkan kepada maksimum dua jam sehari sepanjang empat minggu pertama anda. Pengurus anda akan membantu menyelaraskan beban kerja anda sewajarnya.
notes.zh: 为了帮助大家平稳度过入职期并保障身心健康，入职前四周内每日加班时间上限为两小时。主管将协助合理调配您的工作量。

records.fix: Translate the safety SOP into Chinese and Bahasa Malaysia

out.steps: Please translate the safety standard operating procedures into Chinese and Bahasa Malaysia for new team members. Ensure that all technical terms and safety instructions are accurately adapted so everyone can easily understand them.

notes.en: We are currently translating our safety standard operating procedures into Chinese and Bahasa Malaysia to support your onboarding. The translated documents will be shared with you soon.
notes.ms: Kami sedang menterjemahkan prosedur operasi standard keselamatan ke dalam bahasa Cina dan Bahasa Malaysia untuk menyokong orientasi anda. Dokumen yang diterjemahkan akan dikongsi tidak lama lagi.
notes.zh: 我们正在将安全标准作业程序翻译成中文和马来语，以支持您的入职培训。翻译文件很快会与您分享。

records.fix: Written job checklist on day one

out.steps: Please provide your new hire with a written job checklist on their first day. Walk them through each item, clarify their core daily tasks and key responsibilities, and confirm they understand what is expected of them in their role.

notes.en: You will receive a written job checklist on your first day to help clarify your daily tasks and key role expectations.
notes.ms: Anda akan menerima senarai semak tugas bertulis pada hari pertama anda untuk membantu menjelaskan tugasan harian dan jangkaan peranan utama anda.
notes.zh: 您将在入职第一天收到一份书面工作清单，以帮助明确您的日常任务与核心岗位职责。

out.steps: Please organize and host a weekly team breakfast every Friday morning. Gather your team members together to share a meal, connect informally, and build stronger relationships across the team. Coordinate the food orders or location and encourage everyone to participate.

notes.en: We are organizing a weekly team breakfast every Friday. This gives everyone a chance to relax, share a meal, and connect with teammates across the department.
notes.ms: Kami menganjurkan sarapan berpasukan setiap hari Jumaat. Ini memberi peluang kepada semua orang untuk berehat, menikmati hidangan bersama, dan mengeratkan hubungan dengan rakan sepasukan.
notes.zh: 我们将在每周五组织团队早餐活动。这为大家提供了一个轻松交流、共享美食并与团队成员增进联系的机会。
